command: h=$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home); sudo launchctl asuser $(id -u admin) sudo -u admin env HOME="$h" security find-generic-password -s com.richos.app.bug-reports -a github-reporting-token >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "reporting token lookup exit $? (44 means no such item)"

sudo -n sh -c 'printf "127.0.0.1 api.github.com
::1 api.github.com
127.0.0.1 github.com
::1 github.com
" >> /etc/hosts' && sudo -n dscacheutil -flushcache && sudo -n killall -HUP mDNSResponder; tail -4 /etc/hosts
if curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null https://api.github.com/; then echo 'api.github.com REACHABLE: stop before any post'; exit 1; else echo 'api.github.com unreachable from the guest, as staged'; fi
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to true'

args: What would you like RichOS to do?
It would help if Rich sent me a short summary of the week's conversations every Friday afternoon, so I can see what changed at a glance.

command: cd "$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home)/Library/Application Support/com.richos.app" && ls -laR feature-requests 2>&1 | head -20; true
if curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null https://api.github.com/; then echo 'api.github.com REACHABLE: stop before any post'; exit 1; else echo 'api.github.com still unreachable, about to press Post idea'; fi
cd "$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home)/Library/Application Support/com.richos.app" && ls -laR feature-requests 2>&1 | head -20; true
cd "$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home)/Library/Application Support/com.richos.app/feature-requests/waiting" && for f in *.json; do echo "== $f"; head -c 1200 "$f"; echo; done; true
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to false'
if curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null https://api.github.com/; then echo 'api.github.com REACHABLE at the end'; exit 1; else echo 'api.github.com still unreachable at the end'; fi
